title: ADA Accessibility Specifications for Transportation Vehicles (49 CFR Part 38), Buses and Vans, Excerpt
creator: United States Department of Transportation
description: Federal regulations specifying minimum accessibility equipment for buses and vans, including wheelchair lift design loads, ramp slopes, and securement systems. These standards raised the capital cost of accessible vehicles for all operators. Costs without dedicated federal funding, including by small private paratransit companies like JustGo!
subject: Paratransit; Americans with Disabilities Act; Transportation policy
